answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before it can transact, like a jade token held in escrow. Reputation then grows only from completed work verified by counterparties, so a fresh identity starts as a closed lotus bud with no history to spend. When a gale of fake identities arrives, the stake makes each one costly while honest agents keep their earned standing, raising the price of attack above any profit it could bring.
